build_reference_fallback.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE award_reference AS SELECT internal_id,json_extract_string(try_cast(details_json AS JSON),'$."Tender Ref. No."') AS detail_reference FROM raw_a.aoc_details

reference_agreement.sql: SELECT count(*) AS award_rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE nullif(trim(a.reference),'') IS NULL) AS listing_ref_missing,count(*) FILTER(WHERE nullif(trim(a.reference),'') IS NULL AND nullif(trim(d.detail_reference),'') IS NOT NULL) AS filled_from_same_internal_id,count(*) FILTER(WHERE nullif(trim(a.reference),'') IS NOT NULL AND nullif(trim(d.detail_reference),'') IS NOT NULL AND trim(a.reference)<>trim(d.detail_reference)) AS nonblank_ref_conflicts FROM audit.awards a LEFT JOIN award_reference d USING(internal_id)

build_scoped_keys.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE award_keys AS SELECT a.internal_id,a.portal,a.buyer,a.tender_id,coalesce(nullif(trim(a.reference),''),nullif(trim(d.detail_reference),'')) AS reference_key FROM audit.awards a LEFT JOIN award_reference d USING(internal_id)

build_unique_pairs.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE unique_pairs AS WITH n AS(SELECT internal_id,portal,buyer,tender_id,trim(reference) AS reference_key,count(*) OVER(PARTITION BY portal,buyer,tender_id,trim(reference)) AS k FROM audit.notices WHERE nullif(trim(reference),'') IS NOT NULL AND nullif(trim(buyer),'') IS NOT NULL AND nullif(trim(tender_id),'') IS NOT NULL),a AS(SELECT *,count(*) OVER(PARTITION BY portal,buyer,tender_id,reference_key) AS k FROM award_keys WHERE reference_key IS NOT NULL AND nullif(trim(buyer),'') IS NOT NULL AND nullif(trim(tender_id),'') IS NOT NULL) SELECT n.internal_id AS notice_internal_id,a.internal_id AS award_internal_id FROM n JOIN a USING(portal,buyer,tender_id,reference_key) WHERE n.k=1 AND a.k=1

fallback_join_cardinality.sql: WITH n AS(SELECT portal,buyer,tender_id,trim(reference) AS reference_key,count(*) AS n FROM audit.notices WHERE nullif(trim(reference),'') IS NOT NULL AND nullif(trim(buyer),'') IS NOT NULL AND nullif(trim(tender_id),'') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ALL),a AS(SELECT portal,buyer,tender_id,reference_key,count(*) AS n FROM award_keys WHERE reference_key IS NOT NULL AND nullif(trim(buyer),'') IS NOT NULL AND nullif(trim(tender_id),'') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ALL) SELECT count(*) AS shared_keys,sum(n.n::HUGEINT*a.n) AS candidate_pairs,count(*) FILTER(WHERE n.n=1 AND a.n=1) AS one_to_one_keys,count(*) FILTER(WHERE n.n>1 AND a.n>1) AS many_to_many_keys FROM n JOIN a USING(portal,buyer,tender_id,reference_key)

closing_field_semantics.sql: SELECT count(*) AS unique_pairs,count(*) FILTER(WHERE a.closing_at=n.published_at) AS award_closing_equals_notice_publication,count(*) FILTER(WHERE a.closing_at=n.closing_at) AS award_closing_equals_notice_closing,count(*) FILTER(WHERE a.closing_at::DATE=n.closing_at::DATE) AS same_closing_day,count(*) FILTER(WHERE a.closing_at::TIME=TIME '00:00:00') AS award_closing_midnight,count(*) FILTER(WHERE n.closing_at>a.aoc_at) AS award_before_notice_closing FROM unique_pairs p JOIN audit.notices n ON n.internal_id=p.notice_internal_id JOIN audit.awards a ON a.internal_id=p.award_internal_id

closing_semantics_by_buyer.sql: SELECT n.portal,n.buyer,count(*) AS unique_pairs,count(*) FILTER(WHERE a.closing_at=n.published_at) AS close_equals_published,count(*) FILTER(WHERE a.closing_at=n.closing_at) AS close_equals_close FROM unique_pairs p JOIN audit.notices n ON n.internal_id=p.notice_internal_id JOIN audit.awards a ON a.internal_id=p.award_internal_id GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY unique_pairs DESC,n.portal,n.buyer LIMIT 20

candidate_eligibility_by_closing_semanti.sql: SELECT count(*) AS exact_key_chronology_eligible,count(*) FILTER(WHERE a.closing_at=n.closing_at) AS closing_timestamp_confirmed,count(*) FILTER(WHERE a.closing_at=n.published_at) AS award_closing_is_notice_publication,count(*) FILTER(WHERE cast(a.bids_raw AS INTEGER)=1 AND date_diff('minute',n.published_at,n.closing_at)<72*60) AS short_window_single_bid FROM unique_pairs p JOIN audit.notices n ON n.internal_id=p.notice_internal_id JOIN audit.awards a ON a.internal_id=p.award_internal_id WHERE n.published_at>=TIMESTAMP '2021-06-16' AND n.published_at<=n.closing_at AND n.closing_at<=a.aoc_at AND a.aoc_at<=a.scraped_at AND regexp_full_match(n.tender_id,'[0-9]{4}_[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*_[0-9]+_[0-9]+') AND regexp_full_match(trim(a.bids_raw),'[0-9]+') AND try_cast(trim(a.bids_raw) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 AND regexp_full_match(trim(a.value_raw),'[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?') AND a.value_amount BETWEEN 100000 AND 10000000000

bounded_field_semantics_leads.sql: SELECT n.internal_id AS notice_internal_id,a.internal_id AS award_internal_id,n.portal,n.buyer,n.tender_id,k.reference_key AS reference,n.title,n.tender_category,n.product_category,n.tender_type,n.status,n.published_at,n.closing_at AS notice_closing,a.closing_at AS award_closing,a.aoc_at,a.bids_raw,a.value_raw,a.value_amount,date_diff('minute',n.published_at,n.closing_at)/60.0 AS listed_window_hours,nullif(trim(n.corrigendum_url),'') IS NOT NULL AS corrigendum_link,n.document_url AS notice_document_url,a.document_url AS award_document_url FROM unique_pairs p JOIN audit.notices n ON n.internal_id=p.notice_internal_id JOIN audit.awards a ON a.internal_id=p.award_internal_id JOIN award_keys k ON k.internal_id=a.internal_id WHERE n.published_at>=TIMESTAMP '2021-06-16' AND n.published_at<=n.closing_at AND n.closing_at<=a.aoc_at AND a.aoc_at<=a.scraped_at AND regexp_full_match(n.tender_id,'[0-9]{4}_[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*_[0-9]+_[0-9]+') AND regexp_full_match(trim(a.bids_raw),'[0-9]+') AND try_cast(trim(a.bids_raw) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 AND regexp_full_match(trim(a.value_raw),'[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?') AND a.value_amount BETWEEN 100000 AND 10000000000 ORDER BY CASE WHEN cast(a.bids_raw AS INTEGER)=1 AND date_diff('minute',n.published_at,n.closing_at)<72*60 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,listed_window_hours,n.tender_id LIMIT 12
